moat_against: Subscale vs Thermo Fisher and Danaher, who bundle across the whole lab wallet
Revenue flat for three years (FY2023 $1.137B to FY2026 $1.215B) — moat defends share, not growth
ROIC downtrend: 14.5% FY2022 to 9.3% FY2026 (3.6% in one-off-hit FY2025)
Diagnostics and Spatial Biology segment weaker and shrinking (-2.9% in FY2026)
Demand rides the biotech funding cycle; balance sheet carries a large acquired goodwill/intangible base
moat_for: Reference-standard citation lock-in — R&D Systems proteins/antibodies cited by catalog number in the literature; reproducibility trust beats price
Gross margin 64.8-68.4% every year FY2021-26 — pricing power held through the downcycle
Instrument + proprietary consumable pull-through (ProteinSimple, Lunaphore COMET, RNAscope)
GMP reagents qualified into cell-therapy manufacturing workflows — re-validation switching costs
Net-cash balance sheet; Merck KGaA paying $73 cash / ~$11.3B EV for the franchise
moat_justification: R&D Systems reference-standard citation lock-in and 65-68% gross margins held through the tools downturn, instrument + consumable pull-through and regulated GMP positions; capped at 7 because revenue has been flat for three years, ROIC slid from 14.5% (FY2022) to 9.3% (FY2026) with a one-off-depressed 3.6% in FY2025, and it is subscale vs Thermo Fisher/Danaher. Merck KGaA's $73 cash bid validates the franchise durability the recent ROIC series understates (FY2025 operating income carried the non-cash held-for-sale impairment and litigation/arbitration charges).
name: Bio-Techne Corporation
one_liner: High-quality life-sciences tools franchise, moat 7/10, but standalone owner's-earnings value is ~$13.50 vs the $72.57 price — the price is Merck KGaA's pending $73 cash takeover, not fundamentals; Tier D standalone (5.0% weighted IRR), clears 15% only below $13.50, and a deal break leaves the whole DCF range far below the price.
